"An empty fridge doesn't make anyone happy, right?" As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you make sure customers get their favorite snacks, breakfasts, and groceries delivered right to their door. On top of that, you’ll score an all-in hourly wage of €18.83. Ka-chinggg!

With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it, too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.

Want to know more? Read on to check out the rest of the job opening!

What we offer
- €18.83 per hour from the age of 21
- Get your truck driver's license too!
- Travel allowance and 25 vacation days
- Opportunities for growth
- Weekly pay and a pension scheme
- A great, informal working atmosphere!

Who you are
As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.

In addition, you bring the following to the table:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation to get to Pegasusweg 1  Tilburg.
- You hold a valid category B driver's license (6 months).

What will you do
an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Some days your workday runs smoothly, and other days you run into obstacles—like an apartment building without an elevator or a house number that's nowhere to be found. You’ll experience it all.

Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.

- Working days: Monday through Sunday, part-time or full-time.
- lifting  20 kilo daily
- Flexible hours: 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM (availability for both shifts is required).

Where

Love driving and looking for a great job? Jump into the cabin of a modern truck! As a C/CE Driver at Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, you are the face of a family business. You will drive routes to deliver fresh bread to supermarkets every day. And the rewards? Very good! You get a great salary (Bakery CAO) plus extra money for working night hours. Enjoy a flexible job with a good work-life balance, and we will take care of your yearly Code 95 training. Ready to hit the road? 🌍

What we offer
- €18.21 to €22.12 per hour (excluding allowances)!
- Lots of freedom and independence behind the wheel!
- Peace and quiet on the road
- Build your pension from day one!
- Get your Code 95 and other training via Tempo-Team
- Grab those extra's for working nights & weekends!

Who you are
Would you love to work as a driver in a family business? As our driver, you make sure the fresh bread gets to the customers right on time. You are exactly the person we are looking for if you:

- Have a valid C or CE driving license.
- Have your Code 95 up to date.
- Speak and write good Dutch or English.

What will you do
What does your workday look like?

- Early start & coffee: Start your day between 01:30 and 04:00 AM at the bakery in Alphen aan den Rijn with a hot cup of coffee.
- Load up: Load your truck independently with carts of delicious, fresh-smelling bread.
- Hit the road: Drive a fixed route to about 5 or 6 supermarkets (like Jumbo).
- Deliver & handle admin: Unload neatly at the dock, check the delivery notes, take back empty returns, and fill in your trip reports.
- Done by 10:00 AM! Park the truck back at the bakery and enjoy having the rest of the day completely free! 🥖

Where will you work
About your new employer:

- A proud history: You will join Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, a modern industrial family business that has been around for over 100 years! As part of the Bake Five group, they bake fresh bread for major supermarkets every day.
- One big family:

Are you the type of person who can’t sit still? Do you want to be the boss of your own schedule while singing along to your favorite tracks? Stop searching! As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn in Eindhoven, you’ll jump into your delivery van with a big smile. You’ll bring the groceries right into the kitchen and make the people happy. What a sweet gig! #baanrader

As an Albert Heijn driver,  you deliver groceries to people’s homes using a small truck. Grocery crates can weigh up to fifteen kilos and you’ll often get in and out of the truck. No problem for you! You also:

- Have a B driver’s license ( at least 6 months);
- You Speak Dutch or English;
- You have transport to get to the AH HSC in Eindhoven.

What will you do
As an Albert Heijn driver, you will start your day at the HSC in Eindhoven. Here, you get your route and load the van full of groceries. Music on and on your way to your first address! Today, you will be driving in a city environment. This means a bit more crowds on the road and narrow streets. Luckily you are a good driver and always stay relaxed. At the first address, you unload all the groceries from the box truck. Your hand scanner (Zebra) indicates exactly which crates you need. You place them one by one on your trolley, so you don't have to lift as much. Then

The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
- A clear growth path to Senior Data Center Engineer
